stem: Find the area of this circle in terms of pi.
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 130 120" width="100%" style="max-width:130px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A circle with diameter 12 cm marked right across through the centre"><title>A circle with diameter 12 cm marked right across through the centre</title><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="46" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#1d1d1b"/><line x1="16" y1="60" x2="108" y2="60" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/><text x="62" y="78" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">12 cm</text></svg>
working: Step 1: r = 12 ÷ 2 = 6. Step 2: 6 × 6 = 36. Step 3: 36 × π = 36π. Step 4: 36π cm².

misconceptions.message: You used 12 as the radius. Halve the diameter first: r = 6.
You doubled the radius. Square it: 6 × 6.
That is the circumference, πd. Area is π × r × r.

stem: Find the circumference (the distance round the edge) of this circle, in terms of pi.
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 130 120" width="100%" style="max-width:130px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A circle with radius 5 cm marked from the centre to the edge"><title>A circle with radius 5 cm marked from the centre to the edge</title><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="46" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#1d1d1b"/><line x1="62" y1="60" x2="108" y2="60" stroke="#2b5797" stroke-width="2"/><text x="86" y="54" text-anchor="middle" fill="#2b5797">5 cm</text></svg>
hint: This asks for the edge, not the inside. Circumference = π × d.
working: Not area: this is circumference, C = πd. d = 2 × 5 = 10. C = 10 × π = 10π cm.

misconceptions.message: That is the area, πr². Circumference is π × d.
That is π × r. Circumference is π × d, and d is 10.
You doubled the diameter. Circumference is π × d, once.

stem: A round pond is 6 m across. Taking π as 3, estimate its area in m².
figure: <svg viewBox="0 0 130 120" width="100%" style="max-width:130px;display:block;margin:.4rem 0" font-family="-apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" role="img" aria-label="A round pond drawn as a circle, 6 m across"><title>A round pond drawn as a circle, 6 m across</title><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="46" fill="#e6f4ec" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2"/><circle cx="62" cy="60" r="2.5" fill="#1d1d1b"/><line x1="16" y1="60" x2="108" y2="60" stroke="#1d1d1b" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="5 3"/><text x="62" y="78" text-anchor="middle" fill="#1d1d1b">6 m</text></svg>

misconceptions.message: You used 6 as the radius. Across means the diameter, so r = 3.
That is 3 × 6, π times the diameter. Square the radius first.
That is r². Multiply by π, which is 3 here.
